Rodrigo secured the funding for, led and organised the second IEEE GRSS New Zealand
Radar Remote Sensing School at the University of Canterbury, held from 15 to 17 April 2026. About 30 participants
came from Fiji, Australia and New Zealand, 12 of them on full scholarships, and
Rodrigo taught two SAR laboratory sessions.
